## Level-Up Flow

**1. UI trigger** — `CharacterStateService.setCharacter()` (`frontend\src\app\services\character-state.service.ts:51-54`) checks `checkLevelUp()` (xp ≥ `XP_THRESHOLDS[level]`) and sets `_canLevelUp`. `game-console.component.html:19` shows the "Choose Ability to Improve (+2)" panel with STR/DEX/CON/INT/WIS/CHA buttons when `charSvc.canLevelUp()` is true.

**2. Endpoint call** — Clicking a stat calls `GameConsoleComponent.levelUp(ability)` (`game-console.component.ts:183`), which calls `GameApiService.levelUp()` (`game-api.service.ts:74`) → `POST /api/levelup` with `{ sessionId, characterId, abilityChoice }`.

**3. Backend** — `levelUpRoutes` (`worker\src\routes\levelup.ts`): validates the ability, loads the character, re-checks `shouldLevelUp()` (`worker\src\services\character.ts:159`, using `XP_THRESHOLDS` from `types\index.ts:175`), then calls `levelUp()` (`character.ts:133`):
- `level += 1`
- `hpGain = roll(CLASS_HIT_DICE[class]) + conMod` (hit die per class, `types\index.ts:184`, e.g. Fighter/Ranger d10, Rogue/Cleric/Bard d8, Wizard d6)
- `max_hp += hpGain`, `hp = min(hp + hpGain, max_hp)`
- chosen ability score `+= 2`

It then generates narrative via `generateLevelUpNarrative()` (`ai-dm.ts`), logs a `[Level Up]` entry to `adventure_log`, appends to session history, and returns `{ narrative, updatedCharacter, abilityImproved, newLevel }`.

**4. UI update** — on response, `charSvc.setCharacter(res.updatedCharacter)` refreshes stats, `setCanLevelUp(false)` hides the panel, and a system log entry is pushed. Note: `xp` itself is unchanged by level-up (only level/hp/ability score), so `canLevelUp` stays false until XP crosses the next threshold.
